name: Windsock the Patch-Cap Cat
blurb: Windsock, a white cat with grey tabby patches over both ears, a white blaze and a striped grey tail, sits by the gate to watch clouds.

name: Skypatch the Tabby-and-White Cat
blurb: Skypatch, a snowy white cat with a grey tabby cap, a brown smudge on his nose and a ringed grey tail, gazes up at the open sky.

name: Hangar the Split-Face Cat
blurb: Hangar, a lean white shorthair with a grey tabby patch on each side of his face and a long striped tail, naps in the roomy garden shed.
